name: Iconic Marjorie Hotel, Penang, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel
short_description: A 298-room Peranakan-themed hotel in Bayan Lepas, near Penang International Airport and the Bayan Lepas industrial corridor, joined to Marriott's Tribute Portfolio in January 2026.
ai_summary: Iconic Marjorie Hotel, Penang is a 298-room property in Bayan Lepas that joined Marriott's Tribute Portfolio on 17 January 2026, timed to the Visit Malaysia 2026 campaign. Developed by Malaysia's Iconic Group, its design draws on Penang's Baba-Nyonya (Peranakan) heritage, blending heritage colour harmony with contemporary interiors and art. The hotel sits close to Penang International Airport and Queensbay Mall, positioning it primarily for business travellers, airport stopovers and staycations rather than George Town sightseeing, though a complimentary shuttle serves Queensbay Mall, George Town and the Bayan Lepas Free Trade Zone. Facilities include a rooftop infinity pool, jacuzzi, a 24-hour fitness centre, a steam room and the WellNest Spa. Dining centres on Tiffin Hall, a farm-to-table restaurant serving Malaysian, local and European fare, plus the Loom & Leafs Lounge and the poolside rooftop Senses Bar. In July 2026 the hotel launched what it bills as Southeast Asia's first Sanrio-character Peranakan-themed rooms (Hello Kitty, Kuromi, Cinnamoroll) and afternoon tea. TripAdvisor shows a genuine 4 of 5 rating from about 172 reviews, ranking it #6 of 194 Bayan Lepas hotels. Early independent blog reviews are consistently positive on design, service and dining.

core_facts.address: 239A, Jalan Sultan Azlan Shah, 11900 Bayan Lepas, Penang, Malaysia
elite_benefits: Room upgrades for Platinum Elite and above, subject to availability
Complimentary breakfast or bonus points for Platinum Elite and above, per Marriott Bonvoy program terms
Guaranteed room availability with 24-hour notice for Titanium and Ambassador Elite

pros: Very close to Penang International Airport plus a free shuttle to Queensbay Mall, George Town and the Bayan Lepas FTZ
Distinctive Peranakan (Baba-Nyonya) design, including novelty Sanrio-themed rooms
Strong wellness and leisure kit: rooftop infinity pool, jacuzzi, WellNest Spa and 24-hour gym
Farm-to-table dining at Tiffin Hall well received in early reviews
cons: Bayan Lepas location is business/airport oriented and a drive from George Town's heritage sights
Very new to the Marriott system, so brand-loyalty consistency is still unproven
Some rooms lack a bathtub per an independent reviewer
research_highlights: Confirmed open: joined Tribute Portfolio on 17 January 2026; 298 rooms; developed by Iconic Group
Genuine TripAdvisor presence (4/5, ~172 reviews, #6 of 194 in Bayan Lepas), indicating the property operated before its Marriott conversion
Southeast Asia's first Sanrio-character Peranakan-themed rooms launched July 2026
research_watchouts: Some independent reviews (e.g. dixonthum, Jun 2025) predate the January 2026 Tribute Portfolio branding, reflecting the property's pre-Marriott operation
One prominent blog review is an invited/sponsored 'Invited Hotel Review'

faqs.question: How far is Iconic Marjorie Hotel from Penang International Airport?
faqs.answer: It is in Bayan Lepas, roughly 3 km (about 1.9 miles) from Penang International Airport, and offers a complimentary shuttle service.

faqs.question: What is the hotel's theme?
faqs.answer: The hotel is designed around Penang's Baba-Nyonya (Peranakan) heritage, mixing heritage colour palettes with modern interiors. It also offers Southeast Asia's first Sanrio-character Peranakan-themed rooms launched in July 2026.

faqs.question: When did it open as a Marriott Tribute Portfolio hotel?
faqs.answer: It joined Marriott's Tribute Portfolio on 17 January 2026. The property itself operated before that conversion, so it already has an established review history.

reviews.title: Iconic Marjorie Penang Review: Tribute Portfolio Stay in Bayan Lepas
reviews.author: Paul Lo
reviews.summary: First-person review of the Bayan Lepas property praises the modern design, spacious Junior Suite, Tiffin Hall breakfast and rooftop Senses Bar. Best as a business or airport-stopover hotel, not a George Town base.

reviews.title: My Experience at Iconic Marjorie Hotel Penang – Great Location & Modern Comforts
reviews.author: Dixon Thum
reviews.summary: Independent 3-day stay (before the Jan 2026 Tribute Portfolio rebrand). Highlights the location near Queensbay Mall and airport, a modern Deluxe Room, 24-hour gym, pool and steam room, and Tiffin Hall dining. Main gripe: no bathtub.

reviews.title: Iconic Marjorie Hotel, Penang: A Luxurious Staycation That Feels Like Home
reviews.author: Pamela (StrawberrY Gal)
reviews.summary: Invited/sponsored review praises rooms balancing stylish design with comfort, dining strong on presentation and flavour, and a warm, professional service team. Suited to a romantic escape, family break or weekend recharge.
